target_customer: Subscription businesses in SaaS, media, health and fitness, e-commerce and e-learning that bill recurring payments via Stripe, Chargebee, Adyen or PayPal
problem: Failed recurring card payments cause involuntary churn. Slicker uses AI driven retry timing and dunning to recover them.
business_model: Performance based pricing on recovered revenue (company states if it does not outperform, customers do not pay)

founders.name: Dani Penev
previous_startups: Food delivery startup built with his co-founder at university (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page: several years in payments including global bank transfer products.

founders.name: Ivan Valkov
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built and scaled products and teams from early stage to large companies; employers not named.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs payment processor integrations and a retry timing model trained on failure data, standard engineering with a hard modelling part.

defensibility.rationale: Retry outcomes across merchants could compound into data advantage, but Stripe Smart Retries and dunning vendors overlap with the wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Stripe offers built in Smart Retries and other dunning tools exist; no acquisition of Slicker found.

market_need_then: Involuntary churn from failed card payments is a recognized subscription problem and processors offered only generic retries. Evidence in sources is vendor claims only.

branding.domain_note: Uses slickerhq.com, not the bare .com, implying slicker.com was unavailable (inference from the domain only).

identity.logo: Plain wordmark on white background per site
identity.visual_style: Clean minimal layout, bold all caps headlines
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and proof oriented, 'If we don't outperform, you don't pay'

branding.brand_signature: If we don't outperform, you don't pay
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch dated 2025-01-31 per search listing; no other community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with unrelated trademarks and companies; no press on the brand itself.

pivots.to: AI payments platform with unified payment data and AI analyst plus recovery
pivots.why: Not stated; site now describes an AI payments platform

outcome_analysis: Slicker remains active as a two person London team that sells payment failure recovery on performance pricing, and by its site has widened into a payments data platform. No priced round beyond the YC deal could be verified and no exit or shutdown was found, so the story is still unresolved with limited evidence of traction beyond company claims.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators show 500K (CB Insights: convertible note Jan 2023 with Y Combinator; Nordic9 lists Smok Ventures; Seedtable calls it seed). Sources conflict, likely the YC deal, so no round recorded. Competitor search returned only 2025 and 2026 pages, nothing dated near 2023, so list left empty. The pivot entry reflects current site wording and the date is approximate. Name origin not found.
